meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 代理能直接把网页应用部署到 Vercel,也能查看部署列表、验证登录身份。代理会自动注入 Vercel 凭据,无需用户每次手动输入。
howto.when: 当用户要求代理把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。若 OneCLI 未就绪,会先提示用户运行 /init-onecli 再重试。

say.text: 把这个应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 代理会执行 vercel deploy 并发布到生产。

say.text: 列出我在 Vercel 上的所有部署
say.note: 代理运行 vercel ls 显示部署列表。

say.text: 检查 Vercel 登录状态
say.note: 代理运行 vercel whoami 验证身份。

howto.what_en: Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Agents can then deploy to Vercel, list deployments, and verify authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks an agent to deploy a web application to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, the user is prompted to run /init-onecli first and retry.

say_en.text: Deploy this app to Vercel production.
say_en.note: The agent runs vercel deploy to publish to production.
The agent runs vercel ls to show deployments.
The agent runs vercel whoami to verify authentication.
